_comment: BLIND SQL INJECTION via OOB - SAFE control (must NOT confirm). Drives the sqli_target lab's SECURE endpoint (GET /report-safe?id=), which binds id as a parameter so an injected OOB primitive never reaches the SQL text the DBMS parses - no out-of-band lookup can occur => REFUTED, never CONFIRMED. Boot the lab first: python -m uvicorn sqli_target.main:app --port 8006. Run: python run.py sqli --config examples/run.sqli_safe.json
